from more_itertools.recipes import iter_suppress, sieve, factor

# m1 observable
def gen():
    yield 1
    yield 2
    raise ValueError('err')
    yield 3

result1 = list(iter_suppress(gen(), ValueError))
result2 = list(iter_suppress([], ValueError))
print(f"m1: iter_suppress([1, 2, ValueError('err'), 3], ValueError) == {result1}")
print(f"m1: iter_suppress([], ValueError) == {result2}")
assert result1 == [1, 2], f"Expected [1, 2], got {result1}"
assert result2 == [], f"Expected [], got {result2}"

# m2 observable
result3 = list(sieve(10))
result4 = list(sieve(2))
print(f"m2: sieve(10) == {result3}")
print(f"m2: sieve(2) == {result4}")
assert result3 == [2, 3, 5, 7], f"Expected [2, 3, 5, 7], got {result3}"
assert result4 == [], f"Expected [], got {result4}"

# m3 observable
result5 = list(factor(12))
result6 = list(factor(1))
result7 = list(factor(2))
print(f"m3: factor(12) == {result5}")
print(f"m3: factor(1) == {result6}")
print(f"m3: factor(2) == {result7}")
assert result5 == [2, 2, 3], f"Expected [2, 2, 3], got {result5}"
assert result6 == [], f"Expected [], got {result6}"
assert result7 == [2], f"Expected [2], got {result7}"

print("\nAll observables verified!")
